link_power_management_states.name: Active
link_power_management_states.description: Normal operation at the trained rate (up to 32 GT/s). TX + RX active; TLPs/DLLPs/Ordered Sets flow. Lane Margining can run here without interrupting traffic.

link_power_management_states.name: Standby per direction
link_power_management_states.description: Either TX or RX direction enters Electrical Idle independently. Entry preceded by EIOS; exit via N_FTS FTS.

link_power_management_states.name: Lower-power link standby
link_power_management_states.description: Both directions in Electrical Idle; Link state preserved; exit via Recovery (re-equalizing at 32 GT/s if needed). L1 substates (L1.1 / L1.2) reduce power further.

link_power_management_states.name: Deep sleep
link_power_management_states.description: Both directions in Electrical Idle; REFCLK may be off; wake via Beacon (or WAKE#); LTSSM restarts from Detect and re-equalizes 32 GT/s.

link_power_management_states.name: Off
link_power_management_states.description: Main power removed; re-entry requires a full PERST# cycle.

low_power_modes_summary.L0_active: Full operational power at up to 32 GT/s.
low_power_modes_summary.L0s_standby: Per-direction Electrical Idle; sub-µs FTS-based exit.
low_power_modes_summary.L1_low: Bi-directional Electrical Idle; Link state preserved; Recovery-based exit incl. re-equalization at 32 GT/s; L1.1/L1.2 substates.
low_power_modes_summary.L2_sleep: Deep sleep; REFCLK off; Beacon wakeup; ms-scale re-train + re-EQ.

device_states_d0_d3.description: Configuration Space accessible; aux power; corresponds to L1/L2.
Main power removed; only Vaux; corresponds to L2/L3.

active_state_power_management_aspm.ASPM_L0s_support: Optional; per-direction TX entry on configurable idle threshold.
active_state_power_management_aspm.ASPM_L1_support: Optional; bi-directional agreement via PM_Active_State_Request_L1 DLLP; L1.1/L1.2 substates supported.
active_state_power_management_aspm.ASPM_disable: Default; enabled per-direction via Link Control Register.

fields.gen5_power_considerations: At 32 GT/s the PHY (SerDes, CTLE/DFE, four-phase equalizer, optional precoder) and any retimers dominate active power, raising the importance of L1 substates (L1.1/L1.2) and disciplined ASPM. Re-entry from L1/L2 must re-run equalization to re-open the 32 GT/s eye, increasing exit latency versus lower-rate generations.
fields.notes: PCI Express 5.0 retains the comprehensive Link Power Management framework of base PCIe (ASPM L0s/L1 with L1.1/L1.2 substates, software-driven L1/L2/L3, PCI-PM D0..D3 coordination). The added cost is that 32 GT/s exit paths must re-equalize to recover the eye.
